# TASK-159 — MCP read and write for agents

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Automatic task breakdown and agent access (2026-10-02)

## Intent

MCP additions stay inside the quality gate (names, "Use …" descriptions, hints, output schemas, size budget, no approve/delete/baseline tools): a resource with the whole specification, `list_proposals`, `get_next_tasks`, `import_plan_tasks` (the existing `.plan/tasks.md` into the board, with a preview) and `plan_tasks`. Specification content still changes only through proposals.

## What it delivers

`api/mcp-tasks.ts`. Verified: `tests/mcp.test.ts` (15, including a refusal before any baseline, preview, revision guard, ready tasks released as dependencies finish, import with preview, proposals, the specification resource), `tests/mcp-quality.test.ts` (8, 12 tools, 21,357 of 24,000 characters), `tests/aio.test.ts`. Token creation is rate limited, so these tests store tokens directly.

## History

- 2026-10-02 - CHG-035 Tasks appear when the specification is correct, and agents can read and write the project (TASK-157, TASK-158, TASK-159)
